actions.name: keys.list
actions.title: See each service's keys
actions.description: Shows each service's keys on the Keys page: where each came from, where it is kept and whether it is in use. Never a key's bytes. Changes nothing.

actions.name: keys.author
actions.title: Make the missing service keys
actions.description: Gives every service that has no key yet its own key, made at random by the server. Services that already have one are left alone.

actions.name: keys.replace
actions.title: Replace a service key
actions.description: Replaces one service's key with a new one made at random, or read from an environment variable or a file on the server. Its secrets are sealed again under the new key and the old key is destroyed. A key to paste is never passed here: the operator pastes it on the Keys page themselves.

from.description: Where the new key comes from. Default: random.

path.description: For file: the full path of the file on the server.
